name: McBAIN, the Hon. Kristy Louise

headline.note: Official biographies establish six overlapping occupation ranges from 1995 to 2020, including legal practice and ownership of a plumbing business. They do not identify the early employers, legal-practice employers, business entity, hours, leave or exact transitions. Local and federal elected office is excluded, and neither occupational seniority nor business ownership proves substantive full-time work.

career_spells.evidence_note: Member’s own biography reports helping her parents run a sporting shop as a teenager. Pay, dates and hours unknown; neither paid employment nor unpaid status is assumed.
career_spells.counting_note: Family assistance is recorded separately; no full-time duration without evidence.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies give the role and 1995–2003 range; a public professional profile describes it as work during study. Employer, location, exact dates, hours, leave and overlap with school or university are unresolved. A November 2025 interview recollects pharmacy work during university about two decades earlier. This creates a possible discrepancy with the official 2003 endpoint; the rounded recollection does not justify extending the range to 2005. Her27August2025 parliamentary speech explicitly places pharmacy work in2004, as does a further recollection reproduced by Tony Burke on5September2025. This is a specific conflict with the2003 endpoint, beyond the previously rounded recollection. The existing official range is retained pending reconciliation; do not assume uninterrupted work or calculate another year.
career_spells.counting_note: The occupation is likely private-sector work, but employer control and substantive full-time status are not established.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies give the role and 2000–2004 range; a public professional profile places it during study. Employer, location, exact dates, hours, leave and overlap with other work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: No private full-time duration is inferred from an unidentified, overlapping hospitality role.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies give the role and 2002–2005 range; a public professional profile describes it as work during study. The employing library, government control, exact dates, hours, leave and overlaps are unresolved. Sector corrected from excluded to unknown because the employer is unidentified, rather than inherently excluded work.
career_spells.counting_note: Sector and full-time status cannot be assigned until the employer and working arrangement are identified.

career_spells.role: Bachelor of Communications (Journalism) and Bachelor of Laws student
career_spells.evidence_note: Official and member biographies identify the two University of Canberra degrees, but the reviewed sources do not publish enrolment or completion dates. Multiple occupation ranges from 2000 to 2005 overlapped the reported study period. Her27August2025 speech establishes attendance during2004; this is an observation within study, not an enrolment or completion boundary.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies give a 2004–2005 paralegal interval before legal practice. Employer, location, exact dates, hours, leave and study/work overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: The role does not support a private full-time duration without an employer, hours and exact boundaries.

career_spells.employer: Multiple legal practices — sequence partly identified
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies give legal practice from 2005 to 2018. McBain's biography says she worked across Yass, Queanbeyan, Bega, Merimbula, Eden and Canberra. A public directory places her at 86 Gipps Street, Bega, the same address publicly listed for Clark Rideaux Solicitors, but this is only an employer-identification lead. Employer sequence, exact dates, partnership or employee status, hours, leave and council-work overlap remain unresolved. A later spouse-interest declaration introduces McBain & Co Lawyers Pty Ltd as another lead; its ABN commenced in February 2016. Neither that registration nor spouse ownership establishes Kristy’s employer or start date. Public-profile evidence now identifies two subperiods below; the remaining occupation span is unresolved. This umbrella range must not be added to its component spells.
career_spells.counting_note: A 13-year occupation range and professional title do not prove continuous substantive full-time employment. Umbrella and component spells overlap; never sum both.

career_spells.evidence_note: Self-reported public professional-profile index supplies employer, title and month range. Payroll entity, hours, leave and exact days remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Component of the 2005–2018 umbrella legal-career range, not additive. Private law-firm classification; no full-time duration or July 2009 overlap arithmetic.

career_spells.evidence_note: Self-reported public professional-profile index supplies employer, title and month range. Payroll entity, hours, leave and exact days remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Component of the 2005–2018 umbrella legal-career range, not additive. Private law-firm classification; no full-time duration or July 2009 overlap arithmetic.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies give small-business ownership from 2012 to 2020. McBain, ALP and ABC profiles identify a plumbing business run with her husband and employing local staff. The legal entity, equity, operational duties, remuneration, hours, leave, exact boundaries and overlaps with law practice, council and campaigning are unresolved. Follow-up links Brad to the trading name McBain Plumbing through a contractor list and matching business-site details. A register transcription names McBain Plumbing Pty Ltd as a spouse interest. Legal-entity continuity and Kristy’s employment remain unverified; the directory ABN is a registry lead only.
career_spells.counting_note: Ownership alone does not establish active full-time work or a countable private-sector duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies record council service from September 2012 to May 2020. The role overlapped legal practice, the family business and later mayoral service; exact election and resignation days, allowances and workload are not resolved here.
career_spells.counting_note: Local elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies record executive-committee service from 2016 to 2018. Remuneration, workload and whether the position was held ex officio as mayor are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Association governance is excluded from the narrow employment headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies record mayoral service from September 2016 to May 2020, and a council annual report identifies McBain as mayor. ABC reported her federal candidacy on 1 May 2020 while mayor. Exact election and resignation days, allowance and workload are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Local elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies record deputy-chair service from 2018 to 2020; McBain's biography links the joint organisation to her mayoral advocacy. Appointment basis, remuneration and workload are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Council-linked governance is excluded from the narrow employment headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: ABC reporting records Labor endorsement on 4 May 2020 and the by-election on 4 July 2020. Campaign remuneration, hours and overlap with council or the family business are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official records identify election at the 4 July 2020 by-election and continuing House service. Ministerial responsibilities from 2022 are nested within elected office.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: The six frozen occupation ranges are retained without converting overlapping year-only ranges into additive experience totals.
The lawyer and paralegal employers remain unidentified. A shared business-directory address is documented only as a follow-up lead, not asserted as employment.
The small-business spell is associated with a family plumbing business by member, party and ABC biographies, but ownership is not treated as evidence of full-time operational work.
Council, mayoral, regional-governance, campaign and federal parliamentary roles are separated from paid employment and excluded under the codebook.
No public or private full-time total is calculated because employer identities, hours, leave and exact transitions are not sufficiently supported.

2026-10-01 follow-up adds teenage family-shop work, corrects the unidentified library sector to unknown, and records a primary pharmacy chronology conflict without date arithmetic. Plumbing trading-name and two company leads improve employer identification but do not establish personal labour or full-time status.

Searched legal practices, shared-address Clark Rideaux lead, university chronology, first-speech material, full-time wording, public professional profiles, business directories and registries. LinkedIn returned 999; original APH interests PDF returned 403; directory ABN lookup was inaccessible. The similarly named Tasmanian McBain Holdings business was excluded. McBain & Co Lawyers ABR record was retrieved, but its registration does not date employment. Do not mistake campaign policy support for full-time jobs or business 24-hour service for individual hours.

Second follow-up2October2026 establishes explicit2004 pharmacy-work/study recollection in a parliamentary speech and member-office reproduction, sharpening the official2003 endpoint conflict. Targeted law-firm, LinkedIn index, library and council chronology searches produced no reliable new employer or hours evidence. Shared-address directories remain leads only. A secondary March2020 mayoral-resignation date conflicts with official May2020 and was not adopted. Council date queries yielded no primary exact-day result. Ministerial interview reader failed because robots.txt was unreachable; other accessible sources used. No totals changed.

3October2026 targeted firm searches resolved two legal employers/month ranges from the public profile index. Elringtons is a further employer lead with incomplete dates, not assigned a fabricated interval. Clark Rideaux moves beyond the old shared-address-only lead. No new library/pharmacy identity or work-load evidence; totals remain null.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 repeated exact Elringtons, Clark Rideaux, Symons Phillips and Bega council searches. Results repeated the official2005–2018 legal range, already recorded Clark Rideaux address corroboration and member biography; no Elringtons dates, payroll entity, hours, leave or further legal-employer transition emerged. Directory material is not used to backdate employment.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Elringtons lead checked against exact public-profile URL and named legal-practice/company queries; no personally attributable firm appointment, missing 2005–09/2013–18 employer sequence, dates or hours emerged. Library results describe later ministerial/council work, not her 2002–05 employer. McBain & Co interests remain spouse-owned-company leads rather than her labour evidence; similarly named US McBain Family Pharmacy is unrelated. Old Bega law-directory address repeats already recorded corroboration and cannot establish current work, dates or hours. Keep pharmacy 2003/2004 conflict unresolved; defer these exhausted searches pending original employer/CV evidence.
open_questions: Which pharmacies, hospitality businesses and library employed McBain, and what were the exact dates, hours, leave and study overlaps?
Which legal practices employed McBain as a paralegal and lawyer across Yass, Queanbeyan, Bega, Merimbula, Eden and Canberra, and on what terms?

Can contemporaneous Clark Rideaux and Symons Phillips records corroborate the indexed professional-profile dates, title changes, payroll entities, hours and leave; what are the Elringtons dates and the rest of the 2005–2018 legal-career sequence?
What was the plumbing business legal entity, ownership share, operational role, remuneration, hours, leave and exact 2012–2020 boundaries?
How did legal practice and family-business work overlap council, mayoral and regional-governance duties?
When exactly did council and business duties cease for the 2020 federal campaign, and was campaign work remunerated?
What was the sporting shop’s name and when, on what pay and hours, did McBain help her parents?

Can original interests declarations and historical business records connect McBain Plumbing Pty Ltd and ABN 87 975 114 137 to the 2012–2020 work, and was McBain & Co Lawyers Pty Ltd ever her legal employer?
Does the November 2025 pharmacy recollection indicate work after 2003, or merely rounded timing?
Do payroll, employer or original CV records reconcile the explicit2004 pharmacy recollections with the official1995–2003 range, including any different pharmacy or interrupted work?
